LanguageData.BWT_Settings_controls.fluffy.header_Tool: Contextual controls defined by Fluffy Work Tab. Fluffy uses fixed mouse-and-modifier gestures rather than RimWorld-rebindable key definitions.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_controls.fluffy.expand_Tool: Fluffy's native Ctrl-header gesture is preserved. When BWT owns the tab, the configured specific-job shortcut routes through BWT and Expand beside opens Fluffy-style columns.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_controls.fluffy.batch_Toolt: Shift-scroll changes all capable pawn priorities. Shift-click changes a whole specific-job column; on root Work headers, BWT's optional grouping action owns Shift-left-click.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_controls.fluffy.pawnRows_To: Fluffy's Shift-click and Shift-wheel pawn-name gesture remains available when Fluffy owns the Work tab. BWT-owned layouts keep fixed aligned pawn-row heights.
